file.content: // Existing aria labels on resizable handles className="w-2 bg-border hover:bg-accent transition-colors cursor-col-resize focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-offset-2 focus-visible:ring-ring" aria-label="Resize editor and preview panels" aria-orientation="vertical"

research_notes.finding: Radix Dialog automatically: - Traps focus within dialog - Returns focus to trigger on close - Supports Escape key to close Focus return fix confirmed in releases.
Found 50+ components with aria-label. Coverage is good but inconsistent. Some icons lack aria-hidden="true".
Only 3 components use aria-live: - FileTreeItem.tsx (line 194, polite) - textarea.tsx (line 143, polite) - checkbox.tsx (line 206, polite) StatusBar does NOT have aria-live.
37+ components have focus-visible styles. Good coverage on interactive elements. Consistent pattern: ring-2, ring-offset-2.

architecture_patterns.pattern: Skip links should be: - First focusable elements in DOM - Visually hidden until focused - Link to main content regions via id
Status updates should use: - aria-live="polite" for non-urgent - aria-live="assertive" for critical errors - Role="status" for status messages
Radix Dialog handles: - Focus trap (auto) - Focus return (auto) - Escape key (auto) No additional code needed for modals.

technical_notes.note: StatusBar needs aria-live="polite" wrapper for: - Sync status changes (syncing, synced, error) - WebContainer status (booting, ready, error) - Agent status changes
Skip links should target existing IDs: - main-content (add to main element) - editor-panel (Monaco container) - chat-panel (ChatPanelWrapper)
Audit icons in header bar: - FolderOpen, Loader2, Home should have aria-hidden - Adjacent text provides accessible name
Consider adding role="region" with aria-label to major layout sections.
